name: toons
description: Animated cartoons of what Claude is doing, drawn under the spinner while it works

model.title: Toons: director model
model.description: The model that watches Claude work and directs the cartoons. Haiku is cheapest; Opus is the most inventive. /toons settings shows what each costs.

styles.title: Toons: scene styles
styles.description: Which ways the scenes are drawn: a mix (3D most often, pixel art, text art), one style only, or everything but 3D.

thinking.title: Toons: director thinks
thinking.description: Whether the director model thinks before each scene. Off is cheaper (thinking is billed as output); on may give more inventive scenes. Opus always thinks.

library.title: Toons: ready-made scenes
library.description: Deal ready-made scenes for routine work (reading, searching, tests running...) and ask the director only when something happens: the task, a failure, the end of the turn. Much cheaper; off asks the director for every scene.

pace.title: Toons: new scene
pace.description: How often a new scene is requested while Claude works. Slower is cheaper; each scene keeps animating until the next arrives.
